There are a couple of key points for booting a USB flash drive on a PC. -Drive Format (Fat32 for UEFI systems, NTFS or Fat32 for traditional BIOS) -Setting the drive as ACTIVE (probably what you are missing) -A bootable set of files (it sounds like you have this)

The key thing to do here and you don't even need to format the drive again (probably) is to set the drive as Active. You can do this via Diskpart. Open CMD prompt as Admin > type 'Diskpart' and press enter > Type 'List Disk' > Identify the USB drive NUMBER > Type 'Select Drive (number here) > Type 'Active'

I don't really consider the singularity to necessarily be a thing, but technology is certainly accelerating. There's a really insightful way to figure out how. See what people who are relatively informed in a field are predicting about an imminent technology, and then see how long it takes. A great example is self driving vehicles.

Ask somebody in....

  • 1990 = Hahah, maybe when have flying cars buddy!
  • 2000 = Ooo.. I don't maybe.. maybe 2050 or 2060?
  • 2005 = There still a ways off. Definitely no earlier than 2040.
  • 2007 = Well maybe 2030
  • 2010 = We might realistically see them on the streets by 2025.
  • 2016 = Elon Musk: "In [2018] you'll be able to summon your car from across the country. If your car is in New York and you are in Los Angeles, it will find its way to you."

Even when things are progressing exponentially it's all but impossible to tell from any given instant. We, humans, naturally extrapolate linearly even when we acknowledge things are progressing exponentially. When we keep getting things wrong in the happy direction it's generally a clear indicator of exponential progress.
